gen-dafont-college-gf-preahvihear: College hits hard: bold letters with no swelling or thinning anywhere. Preahvihear gapes open at the letter mouths and rises high, so its size can stay modest without losing anything.
gen-dafont-college-gf-prompt: Dynamic is the first word for College, whose big counters give headings real presence. College announces, but Prompt, with oversized small letters and open apertures, does the quiet carrying.
gen-dafont-college-gf-pt-sans-caption: College leads with monoline strokes and big counters, loud and confident. PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied lowercase and bowls left inviting, and that shared openness is what ties them.
gen-dafont-college-gf-puritan: Puritan reads soft and approachable, its rounded forms staying open. College brings thick curves and big counters up top, and the sans below softly lets all that weight land.
gen-dafont-college-gf-questrial: Questrial cuts its letters flat and stencil-like, with single-weight strokes and short stalks above a tall band. Questrial stays quiet under College, whose thick curves do the shouting.
gen-dafont-college-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big is monoline and tall in the x-height. Paragraph after paragraph of text, its terminals stop short of the stem and the lines stay full and steady.
gen-dafont-college-gf-readex-pro: Professional in tone, Readex Pro leaves broad gaps at the terminals beside College's heavy display letters. And across a full page its sans-serif weight holds steady from word to word.
gen-dafont-college-gf-roboto: Roboto gives round letters generous mouths and keeps capitals close to body height. Roboto handles the steady sans-serif reading, while College saves its spaghetti-like lines and big counters for announcing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-ruda: Curves with the full heft of straight stems define College, an authoritative display heading. And Ruda, a wire-like sans with a sizable x-height, gives it wide-mouthed rounds to lean against.
gen-dafont-college-gf-saira: Saira reads crisp and see-through, with each s showing daylight and rounds stretching high toward the top line. And College, with heavy curves and big counters, supplies the weight overhead.
